items.title: Letter from the Governor to the Daily Mail
items.summary: Letter from Governor Andrew Bailey to the Daily Mail on the subject of AI and cyber-attacks
items.why: Ad-hoc public intervention by the Governor on AI and cyber-attacks.

items.title: Rain applies to establish national trust bank
items.summary: Rain, the enterprise-grade infrastructure for stablecoin payments, announced today that it has filed an application with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to establish Rain National Trust Bank (RNTB), a proposed national trust bank headquartered in New York.
items.why: Fintech firm Rain applies for a national trust bank charter with the OCC.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with United Texas Bank, Quontic Bank Acquisition Corp., and Quontic Bank Holdings Corp.
items.summary: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with United Texas Bank, Quontic Bank Acquisition Corp., and Quontic Bank Holdings Corp.
items.why: Federal Reserve terminates enforcement actions against United Texas Bank and Quontic Bank entities.

items.title: Rain, Modern Treasury seek OCC trust charters
items.summary: p The firms join a growing list of fintech companies looking to get into the folds of federal regulation, days after a trade group sued the OCC over trust charters. /p
items.why: Rain and Modern Treasury seek OCC trust charters amid legal disputes over regulation.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board announces enforcement action against American Express Company to address, among other things, the firm’s failure to sufficiently detect and report certain suspicious activity related to money laundering
items.summary: Federal Reserve Board announces enforcement action against American Express Company to address, among other things, the firm’s failure to sufficiently detect and report certain suspicious activity related to money laundering
items.why: Federal Reserve enforcement action against a major financial institution for anti-money laundering failures.

items.title: New York and Wyoming regulators ink virtual currency MoU
items.summary: The New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS) Acting Superintendent Kaitlin Asrow and the Wyoming Division of Banking Commissioner Jeremiah Bishop today announced a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to facilitate coordinated oversight of entities engaged in virtual currency and digital asset activities in New York and Wyoming.
items.why: New regulatory coordination agreement established between key US state crypto regulators.

items.title: South Korean president orders investigation after spate of bank data breaches
items.summary: South Korea's president, Lee Jae Myung, has ordered an investigation into a series of data breaches at banks in the country.
items.why: Presidential order for investigation into major bank data breaches.

items.title: Basware buys payment fraud prevention platform Trustpair
items.summary: Invoice lifecycle management firm Basware has acquired payment fraud prevention platform Trustpair. Financial terms were not disclosed.
items.why: Fintech acquisition of fraud prevention platform.

items.title: Mynt valued at $7bn for upcoming IPO
items.summary: Philippines unicorn Mynt could achieve a valuation of more than $7bn following an IPO that is set to be the country's biggest ever listing
items.why: Major IPO valuation for a significant fintech unicorn.

items.title: SEC publishes new crypto custody rules
items.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has proposed new rules designed to establish a dedicated legal framework for crypto custody within the wealth management and advisory market
items.why: SEC proposed new rules for crypto custody.

items.title: Modern Treasury applies to establish national bank trust
items.summary: Modern Treasury, which provides infrastructure for global money movement, today announced that it has submitted an application to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (“OCC”) to establish Modern Treasury National Trust Bank.
items.why: Fintech infrastructure firm applying for a US national bank trust charter with the OCC.

items.title: ANZ completes cross-border tokenised deposit payment with Swift ledger
items.summary: Australia's ANZ has carried out a live corporate treasury transactions using tokenised deposits and Swift’s blockchain ledger.
items.why: First live cross-border tokenised deposit payment by ANZ using Swift.

items.title: DNB to lay off 400 and expand use of AI agents
items.summary: Norway's biggest bank, DNB, is set to lay off 400 staff in its technology teams while it increases its investment in AI agents.
items.why: Major strategic workforce reduction directly tied to replacing bank tech staff with AI agents.

items.title: Circle, Ripple and Standard Chartered invest in OKX
items.summary: Crypto exchange OKX has secured strategic investment from Circle, QRT, Ripple and SC Ventures at a $25 billion valuation.
items.why: Major strategic investment in OKX at a $25 billion valuation by prominent firms.

items.title: HSBC to make 'deep, wide and brutal' UK wealth management job cuts in AI push
items.summary: HSBC is planning to axe up to 70% of its UK financial advisors as part of swingeing cuts to its wealth management business driven by riding use of AI, according to the Financial Times.
items.why: HSBC plans to cut up to 70% of UK financial advisors in AI-driven restructuring.

items.title: Singapore central bank issues risk rules on banks' AI use
items.summary: Banks in Singapore must seek an independent review of any forthcoming AI projects before implementation, according to new rules.
items.why: Singapore central bank mandates independent reviews for bank AI projects.

items.title: Wise to pay clients' tax bills after third-party software error
items.summary: Money transfer app Wise has contacted the UK's tax authorities over technical errors that led thousands of clients to pay the wrong amount of tax on their investments.
items.why: Wise to pay clients' tax bills following software error.

items.title: Mastercard to enable offline payments across Europe
items.summary: Mastercard is introducing offline payment requirements that mean that from 2027 Europeans will be able to pay during power and network outages.
items.why: New Mastercard mandate requiring offline payment capabilities across Europe by 2027.

items.title: 'We've heard the feedback': TasWater rethinks big sewerage bill increases
items.summary: Tasmanian businesses and sport clubs had said they were hit hard by the changes to sewerage prices, with one business stating their bill had risen from $630 to $3,800 a month.
items.why: Utility policy reversal rethinking massive price increases following commercial feedback.

items.title: Qld government takes data centre approvals from councils to avoid 'inconsistency'
items.summary: The Queensland government will take the planning and assessment of data centre applications away from local councils under a system set to be rolled out in coming weeks.
items.why: Queensland government takes over data centre planning assessments from local councils, a significant state regulatory change.

items.title: ATO convenes snap meeting over credit card ban
items.summary: Australia's tax chief calls a snap meeting with business groups after the tax office faces backlash over its decision to stop accepting credit card payments.
items.why: ATO calls snap meeting following backlash over its decision to ban credit card tax payments.

items.title: Major share market float of Firmus in trouble as interest wanes
items.summary: The company is reportedly having to price its shares lower as it closed its books to potential investors abruptly overnight.
items.why: Abrupt bookbuild closure and forced repricing mark an unexpected IPO stumble.
